description_en: Queries the daily peak upstream bandwidth of a specific dedicated line for a user
description_zh: 查询用户的每日某种专线上行带宽峰值
kebab_example: aliyun live describe-up-bps-peak-of-line --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --start-time 2017-10-10T20:00:00Z --end-time 2017-10-10T21:00:00Z --line 3 --domain-switch on --domain-name example.com --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeUpBpsPeakOfLine

parameters.help_en: The start time of stream pulling. Specify the time in UTC. The time interval between StartTime and EndTime must be within 30 days
parameters.help_zh: 拉流开始时间，UTC格式, StartTime和EndTime时间间隔在30天内
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of stream pulling. Specify the time in UTC. The time interval between StartTime and EndTime must be within 30 days, and EndTime must be later than the current time
parameters.help_zh: 拉流结束时间，UTC格式, StartTime和EndTime时间间隔在30天内，且EndTime超过当前时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The dedicated line. Valid values: integers in the range of [0, 9]
parameters.help_zh: 专线。取值范围支持【0,9】内的整数
parameters.name: line

parameters.help_en:
The domain name statistics switch. Valid values:

on: Enables domain name-level statistics.
off: User-level data. User-level data is collected by default
parameters.help_zh:
域名统计开关，取值：

on：开启域名统计级别。
off：用户级别数据，默认统计用户级别数据
parameters.name: domain_switch

DescribeUpBpsPeakOfLine.description_en: The daily peak upstream bandwidth information for the dedicated line
DescribeUpBpsPeakOfLine.description_zh: 每日上行专线峰值带宽信息

items.description_en: The daily peak upstream bandwidth information for the dedicated line
items.description_zh: 每日上行专线峰值带宽信息

BandWidth.description_en: The daily peak upstream bandwidth of the dedicated line
BandWidth.description_zh: 每日峰值上行专线峰值带宽

PeakTime.description_en: The time when the daily peak upstream bandwidth of the dedicated line occurs. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
PeakTime.description_zh: 每日峰值上行专线带宽的峰值时刻。日期格式按照 ISO8601 表示法，并使用 UTC 时间，格式为：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ

QueryTime.description_en: The queried daily time. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
QueryTime.description_zh: 查询的每日时间。日期格式按照 ISO8601 表示法，并使用 UTC 时间，格式为：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ

StatName.description_en: The name of the statistics attribute. When DomainSwitch is set to on, the live streaming domain name is displayed. When DomainSwitch is set to off or not specified, the user ID is displayed
StatName.description_zh: 统计数据属性名称。当DomainSwitch取值为on时，显示用户直播域名；为off或者不传值是显示用户Id
